en.headline: Para fencer Tong Nga-ting named flagbearer for Asian Para Games closing
en.dek: The China Hong Kong Paralympic Committee said Tong, who has won three medals in Nagoya, will carry the flag at Saturday’s closing ceremony.
body: Para fencer Tong Nga-ting has been named Hong Kong, China’s flagbearer for the closing ceremony of the Asian Para Games, the China Hong Kong Paralympic Committee announced on Friday evening.
The committee said Tong has performed strongly at the Games in Nagoya, capturing silver in the women’s foil and épée team events and bronze in the women’s épée individual category B.
Hong Kong, China has so far collected two gold, 13 silver and 21 bronze medals at the competition. The closing ceremony is scheduled for Saturday.

zh.headline: 殘疾人劍擊選手湯雅婷獲委任亞殘運閉幕禮持旗手
zh.dek: 中國香港殘疾人奧委會宣布，在名古屋奪得三面獎牌的湯雅婷將於周六閉幕禮擔任持旗手。
body: 中國香港殘疾人奧委會周五晚宣布，殘疾人劍擊選手湯雅婷獲委任為中國香港代表團在亞洲殘疾人運動會閉幕禮的持旗手。
委員會指，湯雅婷在名古屋賽事表現出色，於女子花劍及重劍團體賽奪銀，並在女子重劍個人B組獲銅。
中國香港代表團至今已奪得2金13銀21銅。閉幕禮定於周六舉行。
